cases.name: Update Campaigns Page Layout
cases.description: Makes the operator-selected Veevart Campaign page layout the active layout for the Campaign object across all profiles, then hands off the End Date field reorder and the Lightning Record Page org-default assignment for manual completion.

steps.name: Select and assign the Veevart Campaign page layout as active
Move the End Date field below Start Date on the Campaign layout (manual)
Assign the Veevart Campaign Lightning Record Page as Org Default (manual)
